items.note: Two products: Hot Vacancy ('No word limit for writing job description', company branding, job alerts, multiple response emails) and Classified (254 characters per descriptive field, 2 response email ids, 1 address). sources.title: Pratilipi Help: Daily Series
sources.supports: parts scheduled up to seven days ahead show in the homepage Daily Series widget; parts need more than 200 words; live serials discontinued

items.note: Daily Series replaced Live Serials: writers schedule parts in advance and the series shows under the day the next part is due; readers see the next seven days. Several parts of one series can be scheduled for the same day. A part of 200 words or fewer gets no widget visibility, so each part needs real length and a cliffhanger end. No title or summary limit and no free-part rule were found in Pratilipi's English help on 2026-10-05.

limits.confidence: medium (official PR Newswire India guide, 2024-07-03; a recommendation, not a system cap)

limits.quote: A press release should ideally be around 300 to 500 words.

sources.title: How to Write a Press Release: Tips and Best Practices - PR Newswire India
sources.supports: headline length and case, body word count, SEO advice

items.note: Headline: 'Capitalize only the first word and proper nouns', use audience keywords, read 'like an opening to a news story'. The same page's FAQ says aim for '70 characters or less if possible', so 70 is the safe target and 100 the ceiling. Use 300 words for simpler announcements, up to 500 for complex ones. Formal submission rules (editorial review, source named near the top, no advertising tone) are summarised by search results but were not read on an official PRN page on 2026-10-05.

items.note: Non-Spark ad captions render in white in one uniform font and support no clickable links, @ symbols or hashtags; Spark Ads use the organic post's caption, where @ is clickable. Account name: recommended 4-10 characters in non-CJK languages, no emojis or '{ }'; for app ads it is pulled from the store listing. TikTok is not available in India, so this surface serves non-India campaigns.

items.note: Links: "To reduce spam and scam attempts, URLs placed in YouTube Shorts comments and Shorts descriptions are non-clickable." (YouTube Help 13748639). Mentions and hashtags in Shorts descriptions stay clickable per the same page's table; channel profile links (up to 14) are the clickable route. So a Short's CTA must point to the channel profile link, a pinned long-form video or a spoken keyword, never 'link in description'. Description length is the long-form limit: see plat:youtube_description; title see plat:youtube_title.

items.note: No character limit exists for thumbnail text; the policy limits what it may say. Thumbnails policy bans "A thumbnail that misleads viewers to think they're about to view something that's not in the video" and "Vulgar or lewd language"; borderline thumbnails can be age-restricted or removed. File size: "Mobile: 2 MB for video thumbnails or 10 MB for podcasts. Desktop: 50MB for video, Shorts, and podcast thumbnails." Custom Shorts thumbnails are added in YouTube Studio on a computer and need a verified account.
